modes.name: trunk_forward
modes.plus: Shift the trunk forward over both planted feet.
modes.minus: Shift the trunk backward over both planted feet.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along x

modes.name: trunk_left
modes.plus: Shift the trunk left over the planted feet.
modes.minus: Shift the trunk right over the planted feet.
modes.kept_by: only mode driving l_ankle_ie, l_hip_aa, r_ankle_ie, r_hip_aa

modes.name: trunk_lower
modes.plus: Lower the trunk by folding both legs with the soles planted.
modes.minus: Lower the trunk less deeply by folding both legs.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along z

modes.name: trunk_pitch_forward
modes.plus: Pitch the trunk forward over the planted soles.
modes.minus: Pitch the trunk backward over the planted soles.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along pitch

modes.name: trunk_yaw_left
modes.plus: Turn the trunk left relative to the planted feet.
modes.minus: Turn the trunk right relative to the planted feet.

modes.name: torso_yaw_left
modes.plus: Rotate the upper torso left, sweeping the wrists with both arms held outward.
modes.minus: Rotate the upper torso right, sweeping the wrists with both arms held outward.

modes.name: torso_roll_right
modes.plus: Lean the upper torso right, moving the neck tip right.
modes.minus: Lean the upper torso left, moving the neck tip left.

modes.name: torso_pitch_forward
modes.plus: Bend the upper torso forward, moving the neck tip forward and down.
modes.minus: Bend the upper torso backward, moving the neck tip backward.

modes.name: neck_yaw_left
modes.plus: Turn the neck left about its yaw axis.
modes.minus: Turn the neck right about its yaw axis.

modes.name: neck_roll_right
modes.plus: Roll the head right.
modes.minus: Roll the head left.

modes.name: neck_pitch_forward
modes.plus: Pitch the head forward.
modes.minus: Pitch the head backward.

modes.name: left_wrist_forward_up
modes.plus: Move the left wrist forward and up by raising the shoulder and bending the elbow.
modes.minus: Move the left wrist backward and slightly up.

modes.name: right_wrist_forward_up
modes.plus: Move the right wrist forward and up by raising the shoulder and bending the elbow.
modes.minus: Move the right wrist backward and slightly up.

modes.name: left_wrist_outward_up
modes.plus: Move the left wrist left and up, with outward shoulder rotation.
modes.minus: Draw the left wrist inward while raising it forward.

modes.name: right_wrist_outward_up
modes.plus: Move the right wrist right and up, with outward shoulder rotation.
modes.minus: Draw the right wrist inward while raising it forward.

modes.name: left_wrist_yaw_roll
modes.plus: Deflect the left wrist backward while rotating it about its roll axis.
modes.minus: Deflect the left wrist forward with opposite roll.

modes.name: right_wrist_yaw_roll
modes.plus: Deflect the right wrist backward while rotating it about its roll axis.
modes.minus: Deflect the right wrist forward with opposite roll.

modes.name: left_wrist_pitch_outward
modes.plus: Pitch the left wrist outward and up.
modes.minus: Pitch the left wrist inward and up.

modes.name: right_wrist_pitch_outward
modes.plus: Pitch the right wrist outward and up.
modes.minus: Pitch the right wrist inward and up.

modes.name: left_foot_forward_up
modes.plus: Lift the left foot forward with a folded knee.
modes.minus: Lift the left foot backward with a folded knee.

modes.name: right_foot_forward_up
modes.plus: Lift the right foot forward with a folded knee.
modes.minus: Lift the right foot backward with a folded knee.

modes.name: trunk_roll_left
modes.plus: Roll the trunk left while both soles remain planted.
modes.minus: Roll the trunk right while both soles remain planted.
